source_note: The binaries and tests include preexisting local SVG changes. LHContainer.mm has both optimization and preexisting SVG changes; its complete source hash is recorded. Only optimization hunks are included in this commit. The baseline binary is the published round-four final binary.

comparison.method: Serial baseline and optimized native binaries plus WebKit; reverse order in round two. Both native binaries enable the published scroll batching and obsolete-raster cancellation. Selected uses bounded local paint reuse, compact shadow cache, exact alpha scans and logical layer ordering. Experimental scroll-owned takeover is disabled. Transport recording disabled. CPU is percent of one core, including WebKit helpers, excluding WindowServer. Host callbacks are not display FPS.

fixed_work_comparison.method: Same release renderer test binary, 120 contained tracks and 60 completed mutation states. One state in flight; document and scroll tile completion checked. Applied state and fresh installed-tree pixel checks run outside measured intervals. Process CPU includes worker threads. Elapsed time includes renderer queue draining and test completion barriers. This is a renderer-component comparison, not WebKit, full-host throughput or display FPS.
fixed_work_comparison.order: Reuse setting reversed in alternate rounds

comparison.method: Serial baseline and optimized native binaries plus WebKit; reverse order in round two. Both native binaries enable the published scroll batching and obsolete-raster cancellation. Optimized enables logical paint admission and bounded local paint reuse. Transport recording disabled. CPU is percent of one core, including WebKit helpers, excluding WindowServer. Host callbacks are not display FPS.

scroll_owned_takeover.decision: Disabled by default. Fractional sampling changed ticker pixels beyond small antialiasing differences, and lower CPU accompanied fewer host callbacks. TW_SCROLL_COMPOSITOR_TAKEOVER=1 is experimental only.

canonical_horizontal_origin.decision: Removed from production source. Reduced compositor rasters from 6160 to 120 in a probe, but changed text and solid edges (maximum channel difference 156). Integer CSS translation alone does not establish equivalent sampling relative to the viewport.

import json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageStat
root=Path('/private/tmp/widget-stress-round5')
repo=Path('/Users/renoir/projects/Telegram/telegrammacos')
folder=root/'frozen-final';folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
rows=[]
for fixture in sorted((repo/'tools/perflab/widget-stress').glob('*.html')):
 html=folder/fixture.name
 html.write_text(fixture.read_text()+'<script>setTimeout(function(){window.stress.freeze();},1000);</script>')
 images={}
 for variant in ['before','after']+(['webkit'] if fixture.stem=='clipped-ticker' else []):
  lab=root/('TwidgetLab-before' if variant=='before' else 'TwidgetLab-final')
  out=folder/(fixture.stem+'-'+variant)
  result=subprocess.run([str(lab),'capture',str(html),'--renderer','web' if variant=='webkit' else 'lite','--out',str(out),'--width','480','--max-height','6000','--theme','dark','--seconds','3.5','--logs','--visible','--screenshot'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
  log=result.stdout+result.stderr
  (folder/(fixture.stem+'-'+variant+'.log')).write_text(log)
  assert result.returncode==0 and 'rendered=true dead=- error=-' in log,(fixture.name,variant,log[-1000:])
  images[variant]=Image.open(out/(fixture.stem+('.png' if variant=='webkit' else '.lite.png'))).convert('RGBA')
 a,b=images['before'],images['after']
 assert a.size==b.size,(fixture.name,a.size,b.size)
 delta=ImageChops.difference(a,b)
 row=dict(fixture=fixture.stem,size=a.size,changed_bytes=sum(v for i,v in enumerate(delta.histogram()) if i%256),max_channel_delta=max(h[1] for h in delta.getextrema()),mean_rgba=sum(ImageStat.Stat(delta).mean)/4)
 if 'webkit' in images:
  web=images['webkit'];row['webkit_size']=web.size
  if web.size==b.size:row['webkit_mean_rgb']=sum(ImageStat.Stat(ImageChops.difference(b.convert('RGB'),web.convert('RGB'))).mean)/3
 a=Image.open(folder/(fixture.stem+'-before')/(fixture.stem+'.lite.screen.png')).convert('RGBA')
 b=Image.open(folder/(fixture.stem+'-after')/(fixture.stem+'.lite.screen.png')).convert('RGBA')
 assert a.size==b.size
 d=ImageChops.difference(a,b)
 row['window_size']=a.size
 row['window_changed_bytes']=sum(v for i,v in enumerate(d.histogram()) if i%256)
 row['window_max_channel_delta']=max(h[1] for h in d.getextrema())
 rows.append(row);print(row,flush=True)
 (folder/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
